en.t: Osumi began to lament without stopping.

units.source_text: 说着说着，阿住自己也被自己讲的话触痛，越来越伤感。

en.t: As she went on talking, Osumi herself was hurt by her own words and grew more and more sorrowful.

units.source_text: 最后，阿住满脸皱纹的脸上流下了两行热泪。

en.t: At last, two streams of hot tears ran down Osumi's wrinkled face.
